sample_unit: veterans with SCID-5 interviews and VA EHR visit data

links.outcome: Model performance predicting EHR-based diagnosis versus SCID-5 interview-based diagnosis (reference standard quality)
links.effect: EHR-diagnosis models AUC .85-.9, MCC .58-.69; interview-based models AUC .71-.76, MCC .24-.28. EHR vs SCID-5 concordance 73.3%, 17.8% false negatives, 8.9% false positives.
links.quote: Predictive models of PTSD built using only EHR data demonstrated inflated performance metrics relative to models predicting diagnosis from a rigorous structured clinical interview.

unlisted_practices: Validating EHR-derived diagnostic labels against a structured clinical interview gold standard before using them as prediction targets

screen.reason: Empirically investigates label bias and valid ground-truth selection by comparing models trained to predict EHR proxy diagnoses versus validated structured clinical interview diagnoses.

primary.practice: external gold-standard validation vs EHR proxy label validation
